info.title: Midjourney V8.2 Image Generation Interface
info.description: Create image generation tasks using the Midjourney V8.2 model

post.description:
- Midjourney V8.2 model supports generating high-quality images via natural language prompts. Fast / Turbo mode returns 4 images per generation; Draft mode returns 24 lightweight 0.5K sketch images in a single run
- Supports text-to-image and image-to-image (reference image URLs in prompt)
- V8.2 highlights: an aesthetics and image-quality upgrade over V8.1, a new `detail` level (1-4, maps to native `--quality`), native HD output (`quality=hd`), and a `turbo` speed mode
- Style Reference (`--sref`) is supported; `--oref` / `--cref` are **not** supported on V8.2 and are rejected by the upstream, see [Prompt Parameter Guide](/en/api-manual/image-series/midjourney/midjourney-v8-2-prompt-guide)
- Prompt flags that the upstream does not support are passed through as-is: the task fails with the upstream error message and reserved credits are refunded (they are no longer silently dropped)
- Async processing mode, use the returned task ID to [query status](/en/api-manual/task-management/get-task-detail)
- Generated image links are valid for 30 days, please save them promptly
- Timeout: approximately 20 minutes
- Parameter notes: this route runs on V8.2 and does not support niji; set the speed mode via `model_params.speed`, the detail level via `model_params.detail`, and the output quality via the top-level `quality` parameter

prompt.description:
Prompt, supports all Midjourney V8.2 native parameter syntax (e.g. --ar 16:9 --s 500).

**Image-to-Image:** Place image URLs at the beginning of the prompt. Supported formats: .png, .gif, .webp, .jpg, .jpeg

**Image-to-Image Rules:**
- 1 image + no text = **invalid** (will return error)
- 1 image + text description = valid
- 2+ images + no text = valid
- 2+ images + text description = valid

**Unsupported flags:** flags the upstream does not support (e.g. `--oref`, `--cref`, `--stop`, `--bs`) are passed through and rejected with an explicit upstream error; the task fails and reserved credits are refunded. `--v` / `--version` / `--niji` and the speed / quality / detail flags are stripped and controlled via API parameters.
prompt.example: A cinematic shot of a Maine Coon cat on a neon-lit balcony --ar 16:9 --s 500

quality.description:
Output quality

- `standard`: Standard resolution (default), 1x multiplier
- `hd`: Native HD output, 1.5x multiplier. Mutually exclusive with `speed: draft`

**Pricing note:** the quality multiplier is combined (multiplied) with the `speed` multiplier.

speed.description:
Speed mode

- `draft`: Sketch mode. Returns 24 lightweight 0.5K sketch images in a single run (instead of 4), ideal for quickly exploring composition ideas. Mutually exclusive with `quality: hd`
- `fast`: Standard mode (default)
- `turbo`: Turbo mode, faster generation, 2x multiplier

**Pricing note:** `draft` and `fast` share the same speed multiplier (1x); `turbo` is 2x. The speed multiplier is combined (multiplied) with the `quality` multiplier (e.g. `turbo` + `hd` = 3x).

detail.description:
Detail level (maps to Midjourney's native `--quality N`)

- `1`: Default
- `2` / `3` / `4`: Progressively richer detail and longer render time

Image generation endpoint only. **Does not affect pricing.** Do not write `--q` / `--quality` in the prompt; it is stripped and controlled by this parameter.

callback_url.description:
HTTPS callback URL for task completion

**Callback timing:**
- Triggered when task is completed, failed, or cancelled
- Sent after billing confirmation

**Security restrictions:**
- HTTPS protocol only
- Callbacks to private IP addresses are prohibited (127.0.0.1, 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x, etc.)
- URL length must not exceed `2048` characters

**Callback mechanism:**
- Timeout: `10` seconds
- Up to `3` retries after failure (retries at `1`s/`2`s/`4`s after failure)
- Callback response body format matches the task query endpoint
- A 2xx status code is considered successful; other status codes trigger retries
